q: Can I work from home two days a week? What is our remote work policy?
answer:
I couldn't find a remote work policy in RouteMind, so I can't tell you whether two days a week is allowed.

I checked the attendance area, the attendance overview, and the HR desk pages. None of them covers working from home or work location. The closest is the HR desk, which decides attendance situations that the written rules don't cover.

To get an answer, contact the HR desk through a groupware message or at ext. 2140 (People team). Ask whether two home-working days a week are permitted and how to request them. The HR desk page also says to settle an attendance exception with HR before recording it in the attendance system, so it's worth doing that first.
